comment: Fleet placement registry. Targets accept exact owner/repo names, owner/* patterns, or * for all valid owner/repo paths. The fleet-command.yml workflow is dispatch-only; the fleet-queue placement adapter selects a host and provider from live capacity and local session history. Add a surface by adding a registry entry and a compatible workflow. Advisory fields (documentation only, never enforced by placement): owners.*.plan, owners.*.private_minutes_monthly, the codespace budget.core_hours_monthly, and max_live.

laptop.note: Saturation signal for the codespace tier. Set from pm-dispatch/queue depth where a caller can read it, else flip by hand or pass --laptop-busy. Deliberately not scraped telemetry.

surfaces.notes: Personal Fleet command runner. Dispatch uses the developing-today GitHub App installation. Its repo secrets include GHCR_ORG_PAT and NIX_CACHE_* for private checkouts, cross-run artifacts, and explicitly requested Nix cache pushes.

Canonical org Fleet command runner. Dispatch uses the authenticated user token. GitHub-hosted Linux is preferred; this host also supports the Blacksmith fallback. The dispatch-only workflow does not wait on PR or main CI.

Public-target-only Fleet command runner. It can target public repositories under all configured owners and increases GitHub-hosted capacity when those account pools are busy. Private targets are rejected because this host has no GHCR_ORG_PAT secret.
Retained for manual org-run workflow use. Fleet placement uses developing-today/fleet as the canonical organization runner so followups share its dependency cache and output artifacts.

budget.rate_note: Blacksmith is orgs-only: 3,000 free min/mo, then PAID per-minute (it charges for public-repo minutes past the free tier). paid_cap_minutes is the registry knob Drew can raise; 0 = free tier only.

surfaces.notes: Linux-only Blacksmith fallback hosted by developing-today/fleet. GitHub-hosted Actions is preferred; the free-minute budget is enforced and paid overage is disabled unless a dispatch explicitly supplies --allow-paid-blacksmith.

budget.note: Personal Pro Codespaces budget: 180 core-hours/mo. A 4-core codespace burns 4 core-hours per wall hour.

surfaces.notes: Existing-codespace surface. Can be pinned with --surface codespace-overflow or selected after Actions capacity is exhausted and the laptop is busy. It does not create Codespaces. GitHub CLI OAuth codespace scope is still required.
Handoff-only placement record. Actual laptop command execution remains in the pm-dispatch/repo-queue lane; this adapter does not run shell commands on the laptop.
